paite: Huai ni chiang in hichibang in na chi ding hi, "TOUPA aw, kipahthu ka hon hilh hi; ka tung ah na hehta mah lechin, na hehna lah adaita, na hon khamuan hi.
heading: Kipahthu Genna La
english: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian hon hondampa ahi a; ka gingta ding a, lau in ka om kei ding; TOUPA Jehovah ka hatna leh ka la ahi, hon hondampa ahi," chi in.
english: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

paite: Huaiziak in hotdamna tuikhuk a pan nuam in tui na tawi ding uh.
english: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

paite: Huai ni in huchi in na chi ding hi. "TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh unla, amin lou un, athilhihte michih lak ah theisak unla, amin pahtawi in a-om chih gen un.
english: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that his name is exalted!

paite: TOUPA pahtawi in la sa un; ama'n thil hoihpente ahihta hi; huai leitung ah theih in om hen.
english: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

paite: Zion a omte aw, ngaihtak in kikou unla, kikou vengvung un, Israelte Mi Siangthou na lak ua om lah athupi ngal a," chi in.
english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great in the midst of you!”
